GVF V-CODES SHEET (v4) — the only valid outcome / reason / queue vocabulary

PTP: (no reason)
No-PTP: No-PTP | R07
ID-F: G01 | G02
NOANS: D60 | NR | DECD | CNA
TR-H: HUM
S8: (no reason) — reserved, not used by call sheet 4

queues: GVF-THREAD
codes are case-sensitive. omit reason exactly where the sheet lists none.
